//! The connections of `greeting list`: it opens the stores the edge reads and writes and returns their
//! clients. This is the only I/O of the edge; the composition takes the clients it returns and only constructs.

/// The clients of the stores `greeting list` reaches, opened once.
pub(crate) struct GreetingListConnections;

/// Opens the stores and returns their clients.
pub(crate) fn connect() -> GreetingListConnections {
    GreetingListConnections
}
